QuestInfo.name: Cause of the Accident
QuestInfo.0: You cleaned up the mess from the accident, but #p2082004# still doesn't know its cause. What could it be?
QuestInfo.1: #p2082004# said that you should be able to use the completed #t3994444# to find a person close to the power of time, then the #t3994444# sent you #bChief Tatamo#k in #b#m240000000##k. Is #Chief Tatamo#k the person you're looking for?
QuestInfo.2: #t3994444# sent you to Leafre. You gained a hint about the cause of the accident from Chief Tatamo.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: EXP 635,436\nCan proceed to The Presence of the Seal quest\n

1.0: What brings a young warrior to my land?\r\n#L0##bWhat do you know about the power of time?#l\n#k
1.1: Only that we all feel its passing, especially an old timer like me.\r\n#L0##bWhat I meant was...the power to overcome time...#l\n#k
1.2: It's... hard to remember things at my age. Why don't you come back a little later, when I've had some time to think?
